draft_en.subject: Gigabit PoE next to the PowerMaster units on Bayiden
draft_en.body:
Hello Bayiden team,

Over the past months you had a product mail from us - "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 20 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

Next to the PowerMaster PoE switches you list (POE8-2, POE24FE-2GE-1SFP), two neutral-brand options from small lots, CE/RoHS: a gigabit step-up - 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $80.7 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); and a budget FE line in the PowerMaster price band - 8 x FE PoE + 2 x Gigabit uplinks, STC-028GFP, $17.9; 4 x FE PoE + 2 uplinks, STC-024FP, $10.2.

One question: which band sells more on Bayiden - FE PoE or gigabit PoE?

Best regards,
Simon
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
